pages.quiz:
COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #5
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES OCTOBER
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Web Development Fundamentals, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Web Development Fundamentals.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Web Development Fundamentals.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Web Development Fundamentals.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Web Development Fundamentals.

2. When learning Logic Gates, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Gates.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Logic Gates.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Logic Gates.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Logic Gates.

3. When learning Computer Network Standards and Protocols, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Network Standards and Protocols.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.

4. When learning Binary Arithmetic Operations, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Binary Arithmetic Operations.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Binary Arithmetic Operations.

5. When learning Logic Circuits, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Logic Circuits.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Logic Circuits.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Circuits.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Logic Circuits.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Remove all guards
   D. Run with the tool

7. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Keyboard
   C. CPU
   D. Monitor

8. When learning Network Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Network Security.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Network Security.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Security.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Network Security.

9. When learning Data Representation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Representation.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Representation.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data Representation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Representation.

10. When learning Object Oriented Programming Implementation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Object Oriented Programming Implementation.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.

11. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Information and Communication Technology
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Input Cable Tester
   D. Internal Cooking Timer

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Logic Gates and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Logic Circuits and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Network Standards and Protocols and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Network Security and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

2. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Gates.

3. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Network Standards and Protocols.

4. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Binary Arithmetic Operations.

5. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Logic Circuits.

6. A — Wear safety gear and follow instructions

7. C — CPU

8. C — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Network Security.

9. B — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Representation.

10. A — Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Object Oriented Programming Implementation.

11. A — Information and Communication Technology

12. B — Never touch live wires with wet hands
